cohort: The cohort consisted of 48 women with unexplained infertility who first conceived via ICSI and subsequently achieved a spontaneous pregnancy.
finding: Gestational diabetes was significantly higher in the spontaneous pregnancy group, while amniotic fluid abnormality, gestational hypertension, and preterm delivery, along with a higher 1st-minute low Apgar score, were significantly more common in the ICSI pregnancy group.
birth_weight: Higher in the spontaneous pregnancy group, but not statistically significant (p=0.382).
